insight: AI can create information from scratch in areas where no better version exists.
why_it_matters: This capability allows for the generation of high-quality content in underrepresented niches, potentially capturing new markets.
evidence_quote: pulling information from the sparse internet, the non-information-dense thing where theres no better version that exists. It, it just doesnt exist. You make it from scratch almost.

insight: The first ads in AI may not be effective, leading to a cautious approach from companies.
why_it_matters: This caution could delay the integration of effective advertising models, impacting revenue generation.
evidence_quote: the first ads wont be great because its a hard problem that we dont know how to solve.

insight: AI-driven advertising could enhance targeting for small businesses, improving their market reach.
why_it_matters: This could democratize advertising, allowing smaller players to compete more effectively against larger brands.
evidence_quote: if AI can make that sort of advertising thing work even better, thats very good for the world.

insight: Long-term ad revenue can fund R&D, creating a sustainable cycle for AI development.
why_it_matters: This cycle can lead to improved models and services, enhancing competitive advantage over time.
evidence_quote: the proposition for ads is that you will make so much money on ads by having so many users that you can use this to fund on better R&D.

insight: The current AI landscape is heavily subsidized, relying on ad revenue for sustainability.
why_it_matters: Understanding this funding model is crucial for founders looking to enter the AI space, as it may dictate their monetization strategies.
evidence_quote: Well, for now, thats cause theyre massively subsidized and theyre gonna be paid for by ads.

insight: Companies fear launching ads in AI products due to potential reputational damage.
why_it_matters: This hesitation can slow down innovation and limit monetization strategies, creating a competitive disadvantage.
evidence_quote: I think what holds companies back right now is really just the, that the competition is not doing it.

insight: The fear of poor initial ad performance is a significant barrier to entry for AI companies.
why_it_matters: This fear can stifle innovation and prevent companies from exploring potentially lucrative ad models.
evidence_quote: It would make headlines if someone launched these ads.

insight: Google's existing ad infrastructure may give it an edge in integrating AI with advertising.
why_it_matters: This could lead to a significant competitive advantage, making it harder for new entrants to capture market share.
evidence_quote: I personally would think that Google is probably gonna be better at figuring out how to do this.
